name: music-library
title: Music library
description: A music library with a menu bar, a sidebar of discover links and playlists, and album rows for Listen Now and Made for You. A podcasts tab shows an empty state with a dialog to import a feed.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Menubar, MenubarContent, MenubarMenu, MenubarTrigger } from '@/components/ui/menubar';
import MenuEntries from './MenuEntries.vue';
import type { MenuGroup } from '../data';

defineProps<{
  groups: MenuGroup[];
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Menubar class="rounded-none border-b border-none px-2 lg:px-4">
    <MenubarMenu
      v-for="group in groups"
      :key="group.label"
    >
      <MenubarTrigger
        :class="[
          group.bold ? 'font-bold' : undefined,
          group.compact ? 'hidden md:flex' : undefined,
        ]"
      >
        {{ group.label }}
      </MenubarTrigger>
      <MenubarContent>
        <MenuEntries :entries="group.entries" />
      </MenubarContent>
    </MenubarMenu>
  </Menubar>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/menubar';
import MenuEntries from './MenuEntries.vue';
import type { MenuEntry } from '../data';

defineProps<{
  entries: MenuEntry[];
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <template
    v-for="(entry, index) in entries"
    :key="`${entry.kind}-${index}`"
  >
    <MenubarSeparator v-if="entry.kind === 'separator'" />
    <MenubarLabel
      v-else-if="entry.kind === 'label'"
      :inset="entry.inset"
    >
      {{ entry.label }}
    </MenubarLabel>
    <MenubarCheckboxItem
      v-else-if="entry.kind === 'checkbox'"
      :model-value="entry.checked"
    >
      {{ entry.label }}
    </MenubarCheckboxItem>
    <MenubarRadioGroup
      v-else-if="entry.kind === 'radio'"
      :model-value="entry.value"
    >
      <MenubarRadioItem
        v-for="option in entry.options"
        :key="option.value"
        :value="option.value"
      >
        {{ option.label }}
      </MenubarRadioItem>
    </MenubarRadioGroup>
    <MenubarSub v-else-if="entry.kind === 'submenu'">
      <MenubarSubTrigger>{{ entry.label }}</MenubarSubTrigger>
      <MenubarSubContent :class="entry.wide ? 'w-[230px]' : undefined">
        <MenuEntries :entries="entry.entries" />
      </MenubarSubContent>
    </MenubarSub>
    <MenubarItem
      v-else-if="entry.kind === 'item'"
      :disabled="entry.disabled"
      :inset="entry.inset"
    >
      {{ entry.label }}
      <MenubarShortcut v-if="entry.shortcut || entry.shortcutIcon">
        <component
          :is="entry.shortcutIcon"
          v-if="entry.shortcutIcon"
          class="size-4"
        />
        <template v-else>
          {{ entry.shortcut }}
        </template>
      </MenubarShortcut>
    </MenubarItem>
  </template>
</template>
